name: The requester of a correction cannot approve it
title: SC-13-04-12 The requester of a correction cannot approve it
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When the manager requests a credit note of 500.00 on a liability of unit "A-5"
And the same manager tries to approve it
Then the approval is refused
And the liability is unchanged
